_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Engineering Manual
summary: Provides the format and content preparation instructions for an Engineering Manual to be used by engineering personnel familiar with the technical requirements of the equipment and system to be delivered.
use_relationship:
The Engineering Manual is use by engineering personnel familiar with the technical requirements of the equipment and system to be delivered.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for preparing an Engineering Manual.  The technical manual shall be prepared for use by engineering personnel familiar with the technical requirements of the equipment and system to be delivered.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Commercial practices shall be used in the preparation of the manual.  The manual shall be fastened between durable covers.  The cover shall be marked with the publication numbers, equipment, and date.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The manual content shall include at least the following (with appropriate illustrations):

children.title: Title Page
children.content: A Title Page that shall contain the publication numbers, equipment nomenclature, purchases description numbers, contract number and manual date.

children.title: Introduction Section
children.content: An Introduction Section that shall include a general physical description of all equipment, explain briefly what it is, and what it will do, and present all information of a general nature applicable to complete equipments.  When the text contains terms not commonly used, definitions shall be included.

children.title: Operation section
children.content: An Operation section that shall explain in detail how the equipment operates and describes all modes of operation, adjustment of controls indicator readings for normal operation and adjustment necessary to maintain normal operation.

children.title: Theory of Operation Section
children.content: A Theory of Operation Section that shall contain a technical explanation of all units and special circuitry used in the equipment.  A Maintenance Section containing the necessary schematic drawings, wiring diagrams, and logic diagrams for complete maintenance of the equipment.  This section shall specifically include an overall block diagram.  An Installation and Interface Section which shall contain sufficient information to install and provided mechanical and electrical information such as inputs, outputs, weight, size, connectors, power, etc.

children.title: Parts List Section
children.content: A Parts List Section which shall contain a tabulation of data on all electrical, mechanical, and operational components in the equipment and system.  For each part that is listed, provided the following:

children.title: Manufacturers name, address and cage code
Total number of parts per item
